claim.title: 事件序列和幂等处理必须可审计
claim.statement: 订单事件流必须同时满足监管审计层和工程实现层边界：监管层要求事件 time-sequenced、可追踪、不可静默丢失；工程层必须定义 event_id、source_system、event_time、receive_time、sequence、dedup_key、idempotency_key、replay_cursor、correction_event_id 和 replay_reason。乱序、重复、缺失和延迟事件必须显式标记，回放或回灌不得静默覆盖原始真实事件。
claim.evidence_summary: SEC/FIX/NIST 支撑交易审计和协议事件语义；Kafka delivery semantics、Event Sourcing、CDC/Debezium 补充幂等、事件重放、变更捕获和 replay 边界。
claim.interpretation_notes: 本候选只定义交易审计链、事件时间和日志治理边界，不输出买卖点、仓位、止损止盈、杠杆、风险阈值或实盘执行建议。

applies_when: 外接项目需要设计订单事件审计链、交易日志、监管报告输入或事件回放证据
AI IDE 需要区分 event_time、receive_time、log_time、manual entry time 和 electronic event timestamp
需要设计 client/broker/exchange ID 映射、幂等键、事件序列或审计日志完整性字段
not_applicable_when: 用户要求具体交易动作、仓位、杠杆、止损止盈或风险阈值
需要法律合规结论时，应由对应司法辖区合规/法律 owner 判断
需要 broker/venue 私有订单事实时，应由外接项目事实层和 Live Execution owner 提供
只有普通应用日志且缺少事件时间、来源系统、actor、原因和完整性证据时，不能声称具备监管级审计链
assumptions: Audit Trail / Clock Sync 是交易工程审计上下文，不是策略信号。
所有 clock sync、timestamp precision 和 retention claim 必须声明适用市场、辖区、系统和事件类型。
候选通过外部审计前不能进入正式 reviewed 知识库。
limitations: SEC/CAT/FINRA 来源主要用于美国 NMS/CAT 语境；ESMA 来源主要用于 EU/MiFIR 语境。
NIST 日志管理来源是通用安全日志治理，不替代交易监管字段契约。
FIX 是协议语义来源，不替代 broker/venue 的真实订单事实。
Kafka/Event Sourcing/CDC 来源只支撑工程模式；外接项目可用等价事件流、数据库约束或审计表实现。

source_refs.evidence_summary: 17 CFR 242.613 describes accurate time-sequenced order records, reportable events, clock synchronization, timestamps, and electronic reporting to the central repository.
limitations: Regulatory rule for CAT/NMS plan; use as audit-trail principle with jurisdiction caveat.

source_refs.evidence_summary: FIX Execution Report supports order/execution event semantics, status transitions, fills, cancels, replaces, and identifiers.
limitations: Protocol schema reference; does not define regulatory retention or venue-specific truth.

source_refs.source_title: NIST SP 800-92: Guide to Computer Security Log Management
source_refs.evidence_summary: NIST SP 800-92 supports log management lifecycle, retention, protection, analysis, and operational log governance.
limitations: General computer-security log management guidance; not trading-specific CAT field schema.

source_refs.source_title: Message Delivery Guarantees for Apache Kafka
source_refs.evidence_summary: Kafka delivery semantics documentation explains at-least-once, at-most-once and transactions/exactly-once semantics boundaries.
limitations: Streaming-platform semantics source; does not define trading audit fields.

source_refs.evidence_summary: Event Sourcing records events so systems can replay them to restore state, roll back changes, keep history, and maintain audit logs.
Event Sourcing stores application state changes as a sequence of events and can use the event log to reconstruct past states.
limitations: Pattern source; not a formal regulatory source.

source_refs.evidence_summary: Debezium captures data changes and can include metadata such as transaction ID and old record state depending on source database capabilities.
limitations: CDC implementation source; not CEK-TA mandatory infrastructure.
正式 reviewed 前必须由外部审计确认 claim 没有超出来源可证明范围。
监管资料按地区适用，不能自动泛化到 crypto、外汇、非美市场或全部 broker。
内部字段契约若后续用于 reviewed，需要提供 schema extract 或 contract hash。
